title: Easy Dyes
description: Makes it easier to obtain dyes & to work with them
body:
Easy Dyes is a small mod to make it easier to get vanilla dyes and allows you to turn one color into another (if you have at least one). It also adds new crafting stations to easily create uncolored, black, or white versions of blocks (such as Beds and Terracotta), and lucky blocks that drop dyes.

![animated gif of crafting in the dye station](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LNPFVgoA/images/a2a9598297ead3a3755c10ab4d0c20ae1efb9d94.gif)

## Dependency info
- **Required mods:** none
- **Mods that require Easy Dyes:** none
- **Recommendations:** JEI (for new crafting stations), mods that add new dyed blocks

## General info
- **Usage:** Feel free to add it to modpacks, let's plays, etc.
- **Source code:** is public to read, but not to edit
- **AI disclosure:** Zero AI was used for any of the images (assets and logo), ideas/concepts, patch notes and descriptions. Some code originates from third parties, and usage cannot be confirmed for those, however it is fully put together and controlled by myself. Some AI was used for research (such as understanding Minecraft modding concepts).

## Contents
### Summary
- **8 Blocks:** 4 stations, 3 flowers & 1 other
- **1 Item**
- **41 Recipes**
- **4 Crafting Stations**
- **2 WorldGen features:** Lucky Color Block spawns and spawns of new flowers
- **1 Vanilla tweak:** White Tulips dropping White Dye

![contents](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LNPFVgoA/images/76c1dfe249c3a0eb53ea62b6314eeaa2f063b708.png)

### The Dye Station
<details>
<summary>See details</summary>
The highlight of the mod. Insert the same dye twice, doesn't matter which, and you receive Mixed Dye. This can be inserted along with another dye, converting the mixed dye into that one. Basically, you can convert any dye into another color at a 1:1 ratio, assuming you already own the target dye.

![Guide of how the Dye Station works](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LNPFVgoA/images/9a84fe171b65fce6008f429b63fe8e992d167dc7.png)
</details>

### Lucky Color Block
<details>
<summary>See details</summary>
These randomly spawn in Plains and Forests, can be broken without a tool, and drop a solid amount of random vanilla dyes. This makes it easier to obtain rare dyes such as Green Dye. They can't be crafted

![Lucky Color Block in the wild](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LNPFVgoA/images/01bcdd00d2ecfd9716127e3cfd064733a575f6e8.png)
</details>

### New crafting stations
<details>
<summary>See details</summary>
Beyond the Dye Station, there are three more, that can be crafted and then used to change the dye of vanilla blocks and items.
  
- Bleaching Machine: turns it white, 200 ticks/item
  
- Blacking Machine: turns it black, 200 ticks/item
  
- Dye Removal Machine: turns into colorless version (such as Terracotta), 100 ticks/item

![Examples of what these new stations do](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LNPFVgoA/images/46683c557f9648ad7bea0b171a9e307dff092390.png)
</details>

### New flowers
<details>
<summary>See details</summary>
There are three new flowers for more variation in the world, and easier access to the less common Dyes! They drop the flower, can be crafted into one dye, or smelted for another.
  
- Sea Holly, found near Beaches and Rivers, common, blue & purple
  
- Hellebore, found in Forests, green & lime
  
- Black Rampion, found in Forests, black & brown

![Guide which dyes the new flowers give](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LNPFVgoA/images/0ec0203be2b2c015d527314acc875d8b07112a96.png)

Also, White Tulips give White Dye instead of Light Gray Dye. This makes it far easier to get in peaceful, and there are already many other flowers that give some variation of gray.

![Flowers found in the wild](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/LNPFVgoA/images/c8b13239ef1aaa9e8c3e2493e2d2822cdb26a965.png)
</details>



## FAQ
- _Will you update the mod to [version]?_ -> There are plans to support newer and multiple versions, but I prefer to focus on the version I play myself (1.18 or now 1.21)
- _Will you support other modloaders?_ -> NeoForge is planned for newer versions. I cannot give an answer regarding Fabric until I better understand the differences and porting.
- _When will there be an update and what will it add?_ -> Minecraft mods are just a side project for me, with no fixed schedule. Before an update there may be teasers for new contents on Discord or other social media. When it's released, there is an announcement for it.
- _May I change recipes, disable blocks, etc. for a modpack?_ -> Yes, feel free to use tools/datapacks/mods that allow you to modify such things, for better integration into your modpack/own world!
- _Do I need to start a new world?_ -> Absolutely not. The new WorldGen features being far away is not a problem.
- _How does this mod affect performance?_ -> I don't know exactly, but it shouldn't affect performance more than any other normal mod.
- _Does it support dyes and dyed blocks from other mods?_ -> Sadly, no :(  however, obtaining dyes for dyed blocks/content from other mods becomes easier
